3440d6d89d6d.title: AI Development Engineer
3440d6d89d6d.skills: Operations, Application, Consulting, Artificial Intelligence, Workflow, Operational excellence, Orchestration, Application development
3440d6d89d6d.description:
We are looking for an AI Development Engineer who is passionate about solving complex engineering problems and using AI to improve the speed, quality, and cost efficiency of software development.

The role involves rethinking the traditional approach to software engineering - moving from coding and implementation-heavy workflows to solution orchestration, structured thinking, detailed specifications, system design, and validation.

You will work on building intelligent, agentic applications that combine AI capabilities with traditional engineering systems. The focus is on using AI effectively while ensuring that the solutions we build remain reliable, secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities

**Requirement Clarity and Engineering Design**

* Develop a deep understanding of technical requirements and system-level design to minimise rework and reduce the risk of AI-generated errors.
* Translate ambiguous product and business ideas into clear, structured technical specifications.
* Create specifications that serve as a reliable source of truth for both engineering teams and AI systems.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Establish practices to minimise functional defects and operational issues caused by AI-generated code.
* Identify and eliminate code bloat, redundant logic, dead code, and unnecessary complexity.
* Ensure AI-generated code remains understandable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to navigate.
* Build the right documentation and engineering artefacts so that AI-generated code does not become a black box.
* Incorporate security best practices into prompts, context, and code-generation workflows.

**Agentic Applications**

* Build, maintain, and scale production systems that leverage Generative AI to transform user experiences.
* Design and monitor agentic workflows where AI components interact with traditional microservices to solve complex business problems.
* Explore and implement ways to move from manual workflows to intelligent, agent-driven applications.

**Operational Excellence**

* Focus on rigorous validation as AI accelerates development and output.
* Ensure automated outputs meet high standards of security, performance, reliability, and intended functionality.
* Build deep observability into services and systems to identify and address production issues.
* Explore self-healing production workflows where AI can interpret logs, identify issues, and suggest real-time fixes.

**Cost Efficiency**

* Optimise inference costs through effective prompt engineering, model selection, tool usage, and workflow design.
* Balance model performance, token consumption, and overall business ROI.
* Identify and reduce technical debt caused by AI-generated code and redundant implementations before they affect system performance or cloud costs.

**Organisational Leadership and Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product, Production Engineering, Security, and other stakeholders to align AI capabilities with business goals and responsible AI practices.
* Encourage a culture where engineers can experiment with new AI workflows, learn from failures, and continuously improve.
* Mentor junior engineers and help drive the shift from traditional coding practices towards AI-assisted engineering and system orchestration.

* Strong foundations in Machine Learning and AI, including linear algebra, probability and statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, and standard MLP/DNN architectures.
* Understanding of bias-variance trade-offs, model fitting and selection, hyperparameter tuning, and model performance evaluation.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience and working knowledge of Generative AI foundation models and LLM building blocks, including:

+ Transformers for vision and text
+ Tokenisation and attention mechanisms
+ Prompting techniques
+ Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) concepts
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Hands-on experience with prominent ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face.
* Experience building or working on AI applications across one or more domains, including text, vision, speech, audio, and video.
* Ability to understand complex engineering requirements and translate them into structured specifications, implementation plans, and validation workflows.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in exploring how AI can improve engineering workflows and application development.

* Best-in-class salary: We hire strong talent and compensate accordingly.
* Proximity Talks: Meet and learn from designers, engineers, product leaders, and AI practitioners.
* Continuous learning: Work with a world-class team and stay close to the latest in AI, engineering, and product development.
* High-impact work: Build AI-first systems and products used at scale by global clients.

**About us**

Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media and Entertainment companies in the world! We re headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore. Since 2019, Proximity has created and grown high-impact, scalable products used by 370 million daily users, with a total net worth of $45.7 billion among our client companies.

We are Proximity - a global team of coders, designers, product managers, geeks, and experts. We solve complex problems and build cutting edge tech, at scale. Our team of Proxonauts is growing quickly, which means your impact on the company s success will be huge. You ll have the chance to work with experienced leaders who have built and led multiple tech, product and design teams. Here s a quick guide to getting to know us better:

Watch our CEO, Hardik Jagda, tell you all about Proximity .

Read about Proximity s values and meet some of our Proxonauts here .

Explore our website , blog , and the design wing - Studio Proximity .

Get behind-the-scenes with us on Instagram! Follow @ProxWrks and @H.Jagda

0bd9cca8b485.title: AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation
0bd9cca8b485.skills: Software testing, Downstream, Quality assurance, Load testing, Healthcare, Load, Workflow, Planning
0bd9cca8b485.description:
**AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation - Mid to Senior | Zenara Health** 

**Location:**  Remote - India

**Type:**  Full-time

**Working Hours:**  All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately  **6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST**  , overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

**Commitment:**  Approximately  **50 hours per week**

**Industry:**  Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

**About the Company**

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include  **Assess**  and  **Zenflow**  , which support assessments, care management, clinical workflows, and operational delivery .

We are a startup, not a department. We are building an AI-native engineering team where quality must scale at the same speed as development.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an  **AI-Native Software Engineer focused on QA Automation**  .

This is not a manual testing role.

This is not a role for someone who simply clicks through test cases.

This is a software engineering role for someone who builds systems that prove whether the product works.

Our developers build with AI agents. That means code can arrive faster than traditional QA can review it by hand. We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development .

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it looks fine. We are looking for someone who demands evidence.

**Our AI-Native QA Vision**

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform.

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence - with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality.

You will help design and operate this QA system, including:

* Browser and API test runners
* Synthetic test data
* Isolated test environments
* Requirement-to-test workflows
* Automated checks on every change
* Agent-driven QA workflows
* Evidence generation for releases
* Flaky-test reduction
* Failure routing and debugging
* Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do.

**What You ll Do**

* Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers.
* Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change.
* Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments.
* Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence.
* Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests.
* Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents.
* Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly.
* Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise.
* Produce reliable QA evidence for releases.
* Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys.

**What We re Looking For**

* Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code.
* Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools.
* CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows.
* Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests.
* Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything.
* Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure.
* Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems.
* Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking.
* Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence.

**Our Current Stack**

* TypeScript
* Node.js, Hono
* React
* Prisma, PostgreSQL
* Redis, BullMQ
* Playwright
* Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
* Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines
* Medplum / FHIR
* Flowable
* Claude Code, Codex
* Dify-based AI workflows

**What AI-Native QA Means for This Role**

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

* Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases.
* Review agent-created tests critically.
* Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code.
* Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths.
* Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed.
* Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful.
* Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior.

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence.

**Nice to Have**

* Healthcare or regulated-software experience.
* Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality.
* Experience building test environments and synthetic data.
* Performance or load testing experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug .

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving .

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development .

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
* Fully remote work
* Equipment allowance
* Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
* The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

This role is well suited to someone who:

* Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor.
* Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation.
* Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven.
* Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks.
* Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development.
* Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments.

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct .

**If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.**

**About Us**
------------

**Welcome to the Cutting-Edge of Innovation: ZAZZ**

Step into the world of ZAZZ, a realm where innovative design meets software development brilliance. We're not your average tech company; we're trendsetters shaping the future, crafting digital masterpieces, and redefining boundaries.

At ZAZZ, technology isn't just a tool—it's our canvas, our playground. Our passionate, ingenious team doesn't just adapt to the latest technologies; we shape them. Join us, and you’ll be at the heart of a revolution, influencing, and driving technological advancements.

**Empowering People. Transforming Experiences.**

Ever dreamed of putting your mark on the digital universe? ZAZZ is the place. We breathe life into a bottom-up approach where our employees and users are the stars. Here, you won't just be creating software—you'll be part of a grand journey to revolutionize digital experiences.

**Dive into the Tech Spectrum**

With ZAZZ, you don't just get a job; you get an open ticket to a roller-coaster of challenges and opportunities. From Product Strategy, IoT App Development to the bleeding-edge Blockchain tech, we cover the entire spectrum of tech innovation. Prepare to ignite your creativity and fuel your passion in an environment buzzing with groundbreaking ideas and projects.

**Shaping the Future, Together**

It doesn't matter if our client is a fledgling startup, a dynamic SME, or a Fortune 500 titan—we’ve partnered with them all. At ZAZZ, you'll gain unparalleled exposure and experience in diverse sectors and technologies. You’ll not just grow; you'll evolve.

**Why Join ZAZZ?**

If you're seeking a place where your curiosity is celebrated, your skills valued, and your growth accelerated, look no further. ZAZZ offers a thriving work environment, opportunities for continuous learning, and the chance to work with some of the best minds in the industry. Plus, our team loves to get geeky over a coffee chat on the latest tech!

So, are you ready to leave a lasting footprint in the tech world? Join the ZAZZ family, and together, let's create the future.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This is a remote position.

### **About the role**

One of our client is building a custom AI-native FP&A platform delivered on Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, BigQuery, and the Anthropic Claude API — deliberately built with no third-party dependencies. We're deploying it for a live client engagement: a $500M-revenue, ~1,200-employee, multi-entity B2B SaaS company (US/UK HQ plus several international subsidiaries, PE-backed and pre-IPO). We need a hands-on developer to own the data engineering and backend automation layer so the Principal Consultant can focus on financial design, client relationship, and the AI/context

layer.

  

### **What you'll do**

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from source systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) into BigQuery via Apps Script and/or Cloud Functions — handling OAuth, API rate limits, scheduled triggers, and idempotent retries
* Write and maintain the canonical dimensional model in BigQuery: dimension tables (accounts, departments, employees, customers, fiscal calendar) and versioned fact tables (fact\_actuals, fact\_forecast, fact\_budget, fact\_headcount, fact\_pipeline, fact\_quota)
* Build multi-entity consolidation logic — FX translation, intercompany elimination, entity-level rollups — correctly handling the client's global subsidiary structure
* Own Connected Sheets integration points so finance users work in familiar Sheets while queries run against BigQuery
* Solve the Snowflake connectivity requirement (JWT key-pair auth via raw UrlFetchApp, since Apps Script has no native Advanced Service for Snowflake) if/when that source system comes into scope
* Maintain data quality and reconciliation tooling — freshness monitoring, schema validation, not-null/unique/referential integrity checks (dbt Core or scheduled BigQuery queries)
* Support monthly close, forecast, and quota cycles from the engineering side: fixing pipeline breaks, tuning query performance, managing BigQuery cost (partitioning, pre-aggregation)
* Work from exact specifications provided by the Principal Consultant (column names, SQL, schema definitions) with high fidelity — this is a precision-driven build, not a loose one

### **What we need**

* Strong Google Apps Script experience (triggers, Advanced Services, HTML Service for sidebars/dialogs, quota-aware design)
* Strong SQL and BigQuery experience — partitioning, clustering, cost-aware query design, scheduled queries; dbt Core experience a plus
* Experience integrating with REST APIs from ERP/CRM/HRIS systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, BambooHR, Rippling, Xero/QuickBooks) — auth flows, pagination, rate-limit handling
* Comfort with financial data structures: chart of accounts, GL postings, cost centers, headcount/comp data, pipeline/opportunity data — you don't need to be a finance person, but you need to not be scared of a trial balance
* Experience with multi-entity / multi-currency data models is a strong plus given this client's structure
* Discipline with version control (Git) for SQL, dbt models, and Apps Script code
* Comfort working to exact, detailed specs and flagging deviations rather than improvising around them
* No dependency on third-party iPaaS, ETL SaaS, or vector database tooling — this stack is Google + Claude only, by design

### **Nice to have**

* Prior experience in FP&A, EPM, or financial systems implementation (Vena, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Datarails, etc.)
* Experience with SOC 2 / data governance documentation in a client-facing consulting context
* Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API (not required to build with it, but useful to understand what it's querying against)

The role will involve building scalable automation frameworks, driving shift-left quality practices, establishing QA standards and KPIs, and leading distributed QA teams while partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**QA Leadership & Transformation**

* Lead QA and Quality Engineering strategy across multiple projects and products.
* Define and implement scalable QA processes, standards, methodologies, and quality KPIs.
* Drive **Shift-Left testing** and quality engineering practices across the SDLC.
* Establish automation-first approaches to improve test coverage, release velocity, and product quality.
* Build and evolve QA CoE capabilities, frameworks, reusable accelerators, and best practices.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, test automation, and intelligent quality engineering.
* Drive root-cause analysis, defect prevention, risk assessment, and continuous improvement.

**Test Automation – Python & Playwright**

* Design, develop, and maintain **UI automation frameworks using Python and Playwright**.
* Establish scalable automation architecture using Page Object Model, reusable components, fixtures, and data-driven approaches.
* Develop automated functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end test suites.

* Implement parallel execution, cross-browser testing, reporting, test retry, and flaky-test management.
* Evaluate and modernize existing Selenium-based automation frameworks by introducing Playwright and Python where appropriate.
* Drive automation coverage across critical business workflows and continuously improve automation ROI.
* Establish coding standards, framework guidelines, code reviews, and best practices for automation engineers.

**API & Performance Testing**

* Lead API automation using tools such as **Python, Postman, RestAssured, or Karate**.
* Define API testing strategy covering functional, integration, negative, and contract testing.
* Drive performance testing using **JMeter** and other appropriate tools.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks and work with engineering teams on remediation.
* Integrate API and performance testing into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

**AI-Driven Quality Engineering**

* Explore and implement **AI/GenAI-assisted testing** to improve productivity and test effectiveness.
* Evaluate AI-assisted test generation, test optimization, defect triage, RCA assistance, and regression optimization.
* Define quality validation approaches for AI-powered applications, including:

+ Response accuracy
+ Contextual relevance
+ Response consistency
+ Hallucination detection
+ Prompt effectiveness
+ Edge-case handling

* Participate in designing and validating **Agentic AI workflows and autonomous testing solutions**.

**CI/CD & Engineering Practices**

* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish quality gates and automated regression checks within deployment pipelines.
* Work closely with DevOps and Engineering teams to improve continuous testing and release confidence.
* Promote Git-based development, code reviews, test reporting, and engineering best practices.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop QA/QE engineers across multiple projects.
* Build automation and quality engineering capabilities within the team.
* Conduct technical mentoring, framework reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Define team goals, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Manage distributed teams and coordinate with global stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Business, and Program teams to define quality objectives.
* Own QA strategy, estimates, test plans, release readiness, and quality reporting.
* Communicate quality risks, dependencies, defects, and release recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Support client discussions, solutioning, proposals, and QA transformation initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **15+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering**, with significant experience in QA leadership.
* Strong hands-on experience in **Python-based automation**.
* Strong expertise in **Playwright** for web/UI automation.
* Experience designing and implementing automation frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of Selenium and modern automation framework architecture.
* Experience with **API automation and testing**.
* Strong experience with **CI/CD tools** such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with **Git and modern software engineering practices**.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, STLC, test strategy, and release management.
* Experience with performance testing, preferably **JMeter**.
* Experience leading and mentoring QA/QE teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

7ee6de6119f3.description:
**The Role**

We are seeking an execution-driven Senior Engineering Manager to own the technical architecture, system reliability, and end-to-end delivery of our Agentic AI voice testing product line.

In this role, you will lead multiple cross-functional PODs consisting of:

* AI/ML Engineers (Multi-agent orchestration, MCP server architectures, LLM evaluation & tracing pipelines, STT/TTS streaming, synthetic caller persona generation)
* Full-Stack / Web Developers (Enterprise SaaS dashboards in React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI microservices, real-time analytics, workflow builders, API integrations)
* QA / SDETs (Telecom call verification, regression frameworks, deterministic and non-deterministic test automation)

Your primary mandate is predictable roadmap execution, architectural rigor, and operational discipline. You must be hands-on enough to audit system designs, review critical code, and bridge the gap between probabilistic generative AI workflows and deterministic, enterprise-grade delivery schedules.

**Key Responsibilities  
1. Multi-Pod Leadership & Predictable Delivery**

* Direct and mentor multiple cross-functional engineering PODs (AI/ML, Full-Stack/Backend, QA/SDET), establishing high ownership, code quality, and engineering hygiene.
* Run disciplined Agile cadences (sprint planning, effort estimation, architectural reviews, retrospectives) to guarantee on-time delivery of quarterly roadmap commitments.
* Identify and eliminate cross-pod dependencies, technical debt, and single points of failure through clear architectural documentation (RFCs/ADRs) and rigorous code reviews.

**2. Agentic AI Architecture & Observability**

* Guide the technical design and scaling of multi-agent conversational workflows (dynamic intent exploration, multi-turn memory/context management, tool calling, RAG pipelines, and autonomous task execution) built on LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.
* Oversee multi-model integration strategies across commercial (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and open-source LLMs, balancing response latency, accuracy, and inference cost.
* Enforce production-grade AI observability, tracing, and evaluation pipelines using tools like Langfuse, ensuring every release is benchmarked against hallucination, behavioral drift, and regression metrics.

**3. Full-Stack Platform, Telephony & AI Governance**

* Oversee scalable, asynchronous backend services (Python, FastAPI) and modern web front-ends (React, Next.js), backed by relational, NoSQL, caching, and vector/search datastores (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Vector DBs).
* Architect real-time, event-driven audio and conversational pipelines integrating telephony and messaging protocols (SIP, WebRTC, RTP, Asterisk, Twilio, WebSockets, WhatsApp Business APIs).
* Establish strict AI governance and application security protocols-covering prompt injection defenses, MCP tool permissions, data privacy, and auditability across enterprise customer environments.

**4. Quality Engineering & Organizational Growth**

* Partner with QA leadership to automate end-to-end regression, synthetic call-load testing, and deterministic verification over non-deterministic AI outputs.
* Champion a high-trust, asynchronous, remote-first engineering culture across distributed teams in India, driving hiring, career progression, and performance management.

**What We Are Looking For  
Leadership & Execution**

* 11-16 years of software engineering experience, including 3-5+ years leading multiple engineering teams or cross-functional pods across the full SDLC.
* Proven ability to step into complex, fast-moving codebases, establish architectural visibility, and drive predictable delivery timelines without sacrificing engineering quality.
* Strong command of engineering metrics (DORA, sprint predictability, MTTR, escape defect rates) and practical sprint management for AI/R&D-heavy workloads.

**Core Technical Stack & Applied AI**

* Agentic AI & LLM Orchestration: Deep, practical understanding of multi-agent systems, tool-calling, context/memory management, RAG, and evaluation pipelines using LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, and MCP servers.
* Backend & Frontend Architecture: Strong foundation in Python (FastAPI, async programming), microservices, event-driven architectures, and working familiarity with React and Next.js.
* Data & Search Infrastructure: Hands-on architectural familiarity with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis/ElastiCache, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and Vector Databases.
* Cloud & DevOps: Solid experience deploying and monitoring containerized workloads on AWS (and/or Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* AI Security & Governance: Practical awareness of model oversight, auditability, RBAC, MCP server permissions, and prompt injection mitigation.

**Domain Advantage (Strongly Preferred)**

* Direct exposure to voice AI, conversational bots, IVR systems, and telecom/VoIP infrastructure (SIP, WebRTC, RTP, Asterisk, Twilio, real-time audio streaming, or CCaaS platforms).
* Experience building automated testing, QA assurance, or synthetic simulation platforms.

**Senior Software Security Engineer – AI Trainer**

**Rate - 2.19 LPM**

**Type of Role - Short-term contract**

**Engagement Type - Short Term Contract (3 month )**

**Availability - 8 hours per day with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.**

**Skill**

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.

Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10

**Specifics**

Cybersecurity engineers with any programming language background - 5 + YOE

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer to develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities—including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports—into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.

**What does day-to-day look like**

Source and analyze real-world vulnerabilities from CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories.

Classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to relevant OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate.

Reproduce vulnerabilities and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.

Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.

Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.

Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup procedures.

Harden verifiers against gaming, overfitting, test manipulation, and hardcoded solutions.

Screen out tasks that can be solved by copying a well-known upstream patch without understanding the vulnerability.

Review and score AI-generated patches and reasoning using clearly defined technical rubrics.

Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions.

**Requirements**

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.

Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.

Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.

Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.

Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.

Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Pay: From ₹200,000.00 per month

b43b3e7c1ee7.title: Full-Stack Developer — AI Automation & Business Operations
b43b3e7c1ee7.description:
**Full-Stack Developer — AI Automation & Business Operations (Remote)**

Remote

**About the Role**

We are a Singapore-based company working across Australian hospitality businesses, marketing, and internal business systems.

We're looking for a developer who can build reliable software, understand how a business operates, and take ownership of problems from investigation through to completion.

This is not a coding-heavy role. It involves significant non-technical work, including coordinating with onsite staff, follow-ups, video editing and administrative tasks (you will be trained). Fluent English communication is a must and a dealbreaker.

You will work with senior developers and business leaders on OpenClaw, AI engineering, AI automation, and day-to-day operations. You'll learn workflows firsthand, help execute them, identify what needs improving, and build solutions for the repetitive parts.

Development and operations are both core responsibilities. You should be comfortable moving between coding, investigating operational issues, coordinating with colleagues, and following up until work is complete.

What You'll Work On

Business Operations

- Learn how our hospitality, customer service, marketing, and internal teams work.

- Handle assigned operational tasks directly and identify opportunities to improve or automate them.

- Monitor systems such as GoHighLevel, Goki, email, and booking platforms for missed messages, delayed responses, and unresolved issues.

- Coordinate with colleagues and operational teams, track progress, and follow up until issues are resolved.

- Keep task lists, documentation, and handovers organised.

- Support tasks outside development when needed, including AI-assisted video editing, creative support, research, and administrative follow-ups.

You do not need experience with every platform listed. You do need the initiative to learn, ask useful questions, and make progress independently.

Required Skills and Qualities

- Strong practical development skills in Python or JavaScript.

- Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and third-party integrations.

- Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into applications or workflows.

- Confidence using Linux, Git, and the command line.

- Ability to develop, debug, test, and deploy your work.

- Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory), including the ability to explain problems to nontechnical colleagues.

- Strong organisation, prioritisation, and follow-through.

- Ability to investigate unfamiliar problems and propose practical next steps.

- Willingness to learn new tools and take responsibility beyond your main programming specialisation.

- Professional, empathetic communication with colleagues and operational teams.

We assess both technical ability and how you approach real business problems.

Nice to Have

- Next.js, Express, or Flask.

- VPS infrastructure.

- WordPress or WooCommerce.

- Workflow automation and internal tooling.

- GoHighLevel, hospitality systems, or booking-platform integrations.

- Experience in operations, customer service, project coordination, freelancing, or running your own projects.

Working Days, Hours and Expectations

This is a six-day role, Monday to Saturday. Saturday is a regular working day.

Typical India working hours are approximately 4:30 AM–12:30 PM IST, aligned with Australian business hours.

You should start your shift prepared, organise your priorities, and manage assigned tasks without repeated reminders. Raise blockers early and communicate clearly about progress and next steps.

During assessments and probation, you will be expected to provide brief progress updates every 25 minutes without being prompted, covering:

- What you have completed.

- What you are working on next.

- Any blockers or support needed.

Additional hours beyond your scheduled shift, or work on Sundays, may be required to complete priority work or address urgent issues. Availability and arrangements will be discussed during recruitment.

What You'll Gain

- Fully remote work.

- Direct collaboration with senior developers and business leaders.

- Experience building and maintaining systems used in live businesses.

- Practical exposure to operations, marketing, customer service, and business decision-making.

- Opportunities to take on broader responsibilities as you demonstrate reliable delivery.

Hiring Process

Our selection process includes:

- Review of your CV and code samples.

- A practical technical trial task, completed over a fixed window with periodic progress updates.

- A short recorded voice note explaining your approach (transcribed and reviewed).

- A prerecorded video interview covering communication, problem-solving, organisation, and working expectations.

- A team discussion for shortlisted candidates.

We assess the quality of your work, your reasoning, your communication, and your ability to make progress independently. Recorded responses may be transcribed and assessed using AI-assisted tools.

How to Apply

- Your CV.

- A GitHub profile, code portfolio, or relevant code samples.

- A brief example of an API integration or AI automation you built, explaining your contribution.

- An example of a problem you took ownership of beyond writing code.

Applications without code samples may not be reviewed.

Pay: ₹75,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* How many years of backend development experience do you have, and which language are you strongest in?
* Please share your GitHub profile or code portfolio and identify one project you personally built.
* Describe an AI/LLM or third-party API integration you delivered. What problem did it solve?
* This role includes hands-on operations, follow-ups, and occasional creative tasks alongside development. Are you comfortable with this? Please share a relevant example.
* If assigned to an unfamiliar department, how would you learn its workflow, contribute, and identify opportunities to automate it?
* Give an example of a task you completed independently. How did you organise the work, communicate progress, and handle blockers?
* Can you work Monday to Saturday, approximately 4:30 AM–12:30 PM IST?
* Are you comfortable providing proactive progress updates every 30 minutes during assessments and probation?
* Are you available for additional hours or Sunday work when required for priority tasks or urgent issues? Please explain any availability constraints.

**Software Developer I/II**

**About the opportunity**

* We're looking for an expert **Software Developer III** to join the PVC Product Software Engineering team and help design and evolve the core of RackAI. You'll pair deep **Go** and **Kubernetes** expertise with genuine architectural leadership — and you'll help set the standard for how a modern engineering team builds software in the age of AI. It's a hands-on senior role: strategic enough to shape direction, close enough to the code to lead by example.

* Put simply: **we build AI, and we build with AI.** If you want to work at the intersection of cloud-native platform engineering and applied AI — and help define an AI-first engineering culture — this is the seat.

**What you'll do**

* Design and develop highly scalable backend services in **Go (Golang)**.

* Build Kubernetes-native applications — operators, controllers, and platform services — using controller-runtime and kubebuilder.

* Define and evolve the RackAI platform architecture for growth, reliability, security, and operational excellence.

* Develop the APIs, automation frameworks, and platform capabilities that power AI-enabled products.

* Champion cloud-native best practices: observability, resiliency, and operational readiness.

**Lead an AI-first engineering culture**

* Make AI-assisted engineering the default way of working — champion an **AI-driven, AI-first** approach across the team.

* Embed AI development tooling — **Claude Code**, **Kiro**, **Codex**, or **GitHub Copilot** — across the lifecycle, from design and coding through testing, review, and documentation.

* Set the standards and guardrails for responsible, effective use of AI coding assistants — code quality, security, licensing, and human-in-the-loop review.

* Turn AI augmentation into measurable gains in velocity and quality through prompt engineering and agentic workflows.

* Coach engineers to get real leverage from AI tooling, and continually assess what to adopt next.

**Engineer the platform and infrastructure**

* Design and optimise Kubernetes deployments across multiple environments.

* Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and lifecycle management.

* Partner with Platform Engineering to raise developer productivity and platform reliability.

* Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements.

**Lead and mentor**

* Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.

* Lead architectural reviews and design discussions, and set coding standards and patterns.

* Mentor Software Developers I–III and grow engineering capability across the group.

* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments.

**What you'll bring**

* **Core software engineering**

* Expert-level **Go (Golang)** development.

* Deep **Kubernetes** expertise — architecture, operations, and application development.

* Proven experience with distributed systems and microservices architectures.

* Strong command of RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and service-oriented architecture.

* Hands-on with container technologies such as Docker and OCI-compliant runtimes.

* Solid grounding in software design patterns, CI/CD, DevOps, Git-based workflows, and secure coding practices.

**Experience**

* 2 to 3 years in software development, including 1 or 2-years writing production Go.

* Demonstrable experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers with controller-runtime or kubebuilder.

* A track record of delivering production-grade cloud-native applications.

* Experience leading complex technical projects end to end, and mentoring engineers to a higher standard.

**AI-assisted development**

82d4d0fa8286.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
82d4d0fa8286.description:
Cell Tech Inc. is a US-based device repair business with multiple shop locations. Our shops are hands-on with hardware; our software and infrastructure teams are distributed across Pakistan, India, and Australia. Our internal IT (endpoints, identity, network edge) is handled by a separate team. This role is about everything our applications and tooling run on.

Here is the state of that today: we have production workloads and internal tools spread across AWS Lightsail, Supabase, Render, Lovable, and some local hosting. Some of it is locked down well, some is not. There is no infrastructure-as-code, no configuration management, no centralized health monitoring, and we currently run two separate Bitbucket environments that should be one. Everything works, but it grew rather than being designed.

If reading that paragraph made you start forming opinions, keep reading.

**About the role**

You will own our cloud infrastructure from day one. Not a piece of it — the environment. Your job is to look at what we have, propose where it should go, and then take it there: consolidate the sprawl onto a deliberate architecture, bring it under infrastructure-as-code, make security and patching systematic instead of per-project, stand up centralized monitoring and alerting, and get our costs matched to what we actually use.

We will not hand you a target architecture, because defining it is the job. Leadership here thinks in outcomes: everything centrally managed, secure and kept current, economical, and easy to live with for the teams that build and run things on it. You translate those outcomes into concrete choices — which workloads belong on which services, what the migration order is, what we monitor and where it alerts, what gets a WAF in front of it — and you explain those choices in plain language to smart people who are not infrastructure specialists. If your proposal only makes sense to another DevOps engineer, it doesn't make sense.

You will report to our CIO and CTO, who set direction and priorities and will back your decisions once they understand them. You will work alongside our Systems Administrator where infrastructure meets internal IT; where exactly those lines sit, we will work out together as they come up.

**What you will do**

**Consolidation and migration**

* Inventory everything we run and where it runs, and build the case for where each thing should live.
* Plan and execute migrations off scattered hosting onto the target architecture, without breaking the teams that depend on it. Staged, communicated, reversible.
* Consolidate our two Bitbucket environments into one.
* Retire what should be retired. Part of this job is deleting things safely.

**Infrastructure as code and central management**

* Bring the environment under infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or make the case for your tool of choice) so that what we run is written down, reviewable, and reproducible.
* Establish configuration management where it earns its keep.
* Organize our AWS accounts, IAM, and access so that who-can-touch-what is deliberate.

**Security and currency**

* Make patching and updates systematic across everything we run.
* Lock down what isn't locked down: least-privilege access, no public things that shouldn't be public, secrets out of code.
* Subscribe us to the security advisories that matter and be the person who acts on them.
* Evaluate and propose protective layers (WAF, DNS filtering, and similar) as discussion items with a recommendation, not as surprises.
* Choose and connect a centralized logging/SIEM destination so security events from across the environment land somewhere someone looks.

**Monitoring and reliability**

* Stand up centralized health monitoring and alerting for everything production. If it matters and it goes down, someone finds out from a page, not from a user.
* Establish backups and recovery that are tested, not assumed.
* Write the runbooks and handoff SOPs so that off-hours issues have a path even when you're asleep.

**Developer and team tooling**

* Build and maintain the execution side of CI/CD: build/task runners, pipeline infrastructure, integrating services like AI-assisted code review into the pipeline. (Branch strategy, PR and commit practices stay with the dev teams — you build the rails, they drive.)
* Keep our Atlassian environment organized and sensibly administered.
* Treat the internal teams as your customers. The measure of your work is that their lives get easier.

**Cost**

* Right-size what we run. Find what's oversized, duplicated, idle, or on the wrong pricing model, and fix it.
* Make cost visible: leadership should be able to see what we spend and what it buys.

**Documentation**

* Document the architecture and the reasoning behind it, so the environment survives any one person — including you.

  

**What we need from you**

**Must have**

* 5 or more years in DevOps, platform, cloud, or infrastructure engineering, with real production ownership — environments where you made the architecture calls and lived with them.
* Deep AWS experience in production: compute, managed databases, networking/VPC, and IAM at minimum.
* Infrastructure-as-code in production. Terraform preferred; fluency in the discipline matters more than the brand.
* You have planned and executed migrations of live workloads — moved production systems between platforms or providers without burning the business down.
* Security as a habit, not a department: least privilege, patching discipline, secrets management, and the instinct to ask "what's exposed?" before "does it work?"
* You have set up monitoring and alerting from scratch somewhere, not just inherited a dashboard.
* CI/CD pipeline infrastructure experience (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
* Clear plain-language communication, spoken and written. You will regularly explain trade-offs to non-specialists, and we will test for this.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: given an outcome and a messy starting point, you produce the plan rather than waiting for one.

**Nice to have**

* Experience migrating off PaaS platforms (Supabase, Render, Heroku-style hosting) onto AWS.
* Cloudflare (WAF, DNS, or Zero Trust).
* SIEM selection or administration.
* Atlassian administration (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket).
* Configuration management (Ansible or similar).
* A cost-optimization story with numbers attached.
* Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2 or similar).

**How we think about skills**

We have named the tools we use today, and we have guesses about where things should go — but we are deliberately not prescribing the target stack, because evaluating those guesses is your job. We care that you know the disciplines (provisioning, configuration, observability, access control, cost) deeply enough that any given tool is just the current spelling of them. If you disagree with something we've assumed, we want to hear it — after you've asked why we assumed it.

**Working arrangement**

* Fully remote from India.
* Standard local business hours. This is not a night-shift US-overlap role.
* If something you own becomes 24/7-critical down the road, we will solve that together with handoff SOPs or an on-call arrangement — it is not the default.
* No travel.

### Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making. Type: Remote, Contracted.

### Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

### Qualifications

* Bachelors or masters degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
* At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
* At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
* Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
* Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

### Required Skills / Competencies

* Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
* Cloud Data Warehousing Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
* Modern Transformations Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
* LookML Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
* Data Validation Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
* Communication Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
* Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

### Responsibilities

* Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
* Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
* Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
* Data Parity Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
* Best Practices Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

**Department:**  Engineering   
  **Reports To:**  Product Engineering Leadership   
  **Location:**  India - Fully Remote   
  **Employment Type:**  Full-Time   
  **Experience Level:**  Mid-Level   
  **Compensation:**  15,00,000 - 22,00,000 per year (15-22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise

**Position Overview**

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI System Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions.
* Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity.
* Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation.
* Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption.
* Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations.

**Production Optimization**

* Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost.
* Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch.
* Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users.

**Collaboration**

* Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications.
* Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making.
* Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions.

**Research Experimentation**

* Read and evaluate ML research papers.

* Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable.

* Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems.
* Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.

**Working Relationships**

The AI Engineer will collaborate with:

* Engineering leadership and product teams.
* Software engineers and backend developers.
* Global AI research and development teams.

**Success in This Role**

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models.

You should be able to:

* Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact.
* Translate research into practical engineering solutions.
* Collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
* Document and share technical knowledge for scalability.
* Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities.

**Work Environment**

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones.

**Required Work Schedule**

**This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM-4:30 AM or 8:30 PM-5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time**

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

**Our Hiring Process**

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging.

1. Initial Recruiter Screening

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners.

2. Practical Skills Assessment

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously.

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario.

3. Assessment Review

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role.

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview   
 Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview - CTO

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production.
* Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction.
* Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging.
* Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras.
* Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs.
* Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design.
* Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods.
* SQL database knowledge.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
* Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results.

**Compensation Benefits**

* Annual Compensation: 15,00,000- 22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.

* Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.

* 90-day probationary period.

* Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:

+ Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.

+ Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.

+ Career growth and professional development opportunities.

a0ca73924ad8.description:
Software Testing Engineer

**Company:** Kefilo  
 **Role Type:** Equity-Based Founding Team Position  
 **Work Model:** Part-Time | Hybrid/Remote  
 **Time Commitment:** Approximately 20 hours per week

About Kefilo

Kefilo is a NutritionTech and wellness innovation company building a technology-driven approach to personalised nutrition, preventive wellness and lifestyle transformation.

Our vision combines functional nutrition, fitness, mental wellness, data-driven personalisation and intelligent food systems. We are developing a **Nutrition Intelligence Engine (NIE)** alongside a technology-enabled food ecosystem built around our Dark Factory Model for Food.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Software Testing Engineer to take ownership of product quality, testing processes and reliability across Kefilos digital platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* **Functional Manual Testing:** Test web and mobile applications, identify bugs, validate features and ensure that all functionalities work according to business and technical requirements.
* **Automation Regression Testing:** Develop and maintain automated test cases, conduct regression testing and establish repeatable testing processes to improve product reliability.
* **API Database Testing:** Validate APIs, backend services, database operations, integrations and data flow between different application modules.
* **Performance Compatibility Testing:** Evaluate application performance, responsiveness, usability, security-related vulnerabilities and compatibility across devices, browsers and operating systems.
* **Test Documentation:** Prepare test plans, test cases, bug reports, test scenarios and quality-assurance documentation.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Work closely with developers, UI/UX designers and product teams to reproduce issues, track bug resolution and validate fixes.
* **Release Quality Management:** Conduct end-to-end testing, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure product readiness before releases and updates.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or application testing.
* Knowledge of manual testing, automation testing and software testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman, JMeter or similar testing frameworks.
* Understanding of APIs, databases, SQL, mobile application testing and web technologies.
* Knowledge of Agile development, bug-tracking tools and software development lifecycle.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Experience testing health, nutrition, food-tech, wellness or consumer-facing applications will be an advantage.

Engagement Equity Structure

* Equity-based founding team opportunity.
* Part-time engagement of approximately 20 hours per week.
* Hybrid/Remote working arrangement.
* No fixed salary or monthly compensation until the company secures funding. Fixed compensation will be considered after funding and revenue stabilization.
* Equity participation will be discussed separately based on experience, responsibilities, contribution and long-term commitment.
* Proposed equity vesting period: 5 years.

Selection Process

* Initial strategic discussions to understand experience, technical capabilities and alignment with Kefilo.
* Approximately 3-4 discussions to evaluate mutual suitability.
* One-month collaborative engagement under NDA.
* Finalisation of responsibilities, equity participation and formal founding team agreement.

Who Should Apply

Software testing professionals interested in building reliable technology products from an early stage and taking ownership of quality assurance within a growing NutritionTech venture.

Interested candidates can share their profile along with details of testing tools, frameworks and applications they have worked on.

3a83e0e42164.description:
### Job Summary

As Technical Lead - ATE / SmarTest 8 / Advantest V93000, you will provide technical leadership for a team responsible for defining, implementing, and improving test strategies for SmarTest 8 and the Advantest V93000 (V93K) platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining ATE and semiconductor test engineering, software development, and technical team coordination.

You will work directly on test strategy, automation, CI/CD integration, customer device programs, validation, and debugging while guiding the technical work of the team.

You will work closely with product owners, developers, test engineers, subcontractors, and global engineering teams.

The role requires strong practical experience with V93000, SmarTest 8, Java, Python, and test automation, together with the ability to provide technical direction and develop engineers within the team.

### Key Responsibilities

* Provide technical leadership for the team, define technical priorities together with the product owner, coordinate engineering activities, review technical solutions, and ensure consistent implementation and test quality.
* Own and continuously improve the SmarTest 8 test strategy, including test coverage, validation, regression testing, reporting, and release testing.
* Design and contribute hands-on to test automation, tools, and utilities using Java, Python, and scripting languages. Drive Offline Result Emulation (ORE), CI/CD integration, device deployment, and application performance monitoring.
* Work with customer device programs on the V93000 platform. Guide online and offline testing, test method development and optimization, result analysis, debugging, and root-cause analysis across software and hardware.
* Lead the validation of new SmarTest 8 software features and V93000 hardware capabilities and ensure that test methods, automation, and validation approaches are technically sound and maintainable.
* Guide and mentor engineers, support technical problem solving and knowledge sharing, and work with global teams and subcontractors to improve engineering practices and automation coverage.
* Contribute to Agile planning and continuously improve development, testing, and delivery processes.

### Required Qualifications Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with strong professional experience in ATE, semiconductor test engineering, and software development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Advantest V93000, including good knowledge of SmartScale, EXA Scale, and SmarTest 8. SmarTest 7 experience is an advantage.
* Hands-on software development experience with Java and Python, including object-oriented programming, software design, code reviews, and source code management with Git.
* Experience developing test automation frameworks and tools, including scripting with Shell, Perl, TCL, or similar technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, test method development, debugging, and software/hardware validation, including systematic root-cause analysis.
* Experience with AI-assisted and AI-native software development workflows and the ability to introduce effective AI-based development and testing practices within the team.
* Experience providing technical leadership, including guiding engineers, coordinating technical work, reviewing solutions, and driving technical decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good English communication skills, and experience working with distributed engineering teams.

### Nice to Have

* Experience leading technical work in an Agile development team and working with Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.
* Good understanding of semiconductor test processes, ATE technologies, and Linux environments, particularly RHEL.
* Experience developing data analysis, reporting, or visualization solutions using Python.
* Experience mentoring engineers and building technical knowledge within a team.

We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Java Developer to build, test and support enterprise applications. In this role, you will bring strong Java, Spring Boot, REST API and SQL skills together with exposure to modern frontend technologies to deliver high-quality, secure software solutions.

Day to day, you will design, develop and maintain enterprise applications, build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices and database components, and support user-interface development. You will work closely with business analysts, QA and engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, taking part in code reviews, CI/CD processes, deployments and production support.

This role also requires an AI-tool-ready mindset: you will use approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, testing, debugging and documentation activities, while critically validating all AI-generated output for correctness, security and maintainability.

### **Essential Job Functions**

* Design, develop, test and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.

* JPA/Hibernate or an equivalent ORM framework.

286606ade5d7.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

The Accountant is responsible for overseeing the financial activities of the organization, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in financial reporting and analysis. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive knowledge of accounting principles and regulations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Financial Reporting:

* Prepare and analyze financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulations (GAAP, IFRS, etc.).
* Generate financial reports for internal and external stakeholders, such as management, investors, and regulatory agencies.

2. General Ledger Management:

* Maintain the integrity of the general ledger and subsidiary ledgers.
* Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Review and post journal entries as necessary.

3. Budgeting and Forecasting:

* Assist in the development of annual budgets and financial forecasts.
* Monitor budget variances and provide analysis to management.
* Recommend adjustments to budgetary allocations as needed.

4. Financial Analysis:

* Conduct financial analysis to support decision-making processes.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and risks within the financial data.
* Present findings and recommendations to management.

5. Audit and Compliance:

* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during financial audits.
* Ensure compliance with tax regulations and assist with tax filings.
* Develop and implement internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure accuracy of financial records.

6. Process Improvement:

* Identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and enhance efficiency.
* Implement best practices and automation tools to improve productivity.
* Provide training and guidance to junior accounting staff.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
* US Taxation Experience
* Proven experience (typically 1+ years) in accounting or finance roles, with increasing levels of responsibility.
* Thorough knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and regulations.
* Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Xero, QuickBooks).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines.

  

**Perks and benefits**

  

* Opportunities for promotion
* Paid training
* Work from home
* Schedule: 6-8 hour shift
* Flexible shift

\*Automation Developer\*

Remote | Full-time | 3-5 Years

\*The Role:\*

We are hiring an Automation Developer who can translate the day-to-day needs of our accounting team into reliable cloud-based tools. You will work closely with team members, understand what they actually need, and build solutions that are simple to use, fully accurate, and easy to maintain. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who genuinely enjoys turning messy, manual workflows into clean automated systems and who can explain in plain English what the program is doing and why.

\*Responsibilities:\*

- \*Understand requirements:\* Sit with team members, listen to the problem they are trying to solve, and translate it into a clear scope before writing a single line of code.

- \*Build cloud-based applications:\* Design and develop tools using modern stacks (Python, JavaScript/Node.js, SQL databases like PostgreSQL/MySQL, REST APIs and Webhooks) to replace legacy Excel/VBA macros.

- \*Ensure 100% accuracy:\* Build validation checks, reconciliation logic, and audit trails into every tool. Accounting work has no room for silent errors.

- \*Maintain and scale:\* Keep tools running smoothly as the team grows and client requirements change.

\*Required Skills:\*

- Python

- Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills

### Job Summary

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, youll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. With our team, youll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. Youll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

Were looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what theyre learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.
