7c17d8e5545d.description:
**The Role**

Our clients build in healthcare, fintech, and payments, where an architecture mistake can become a compliance failure. As Principal Engineer, you ll be the person who makes those architecture calls. You ll set the technical direction, decide how systems are built and secured, and stay hands-on enough to prove your designs in code. Our Senior Full-Stack Engineers build features within the architecture you define.

**About Techdome**

Techdome is a product-driven engineering organization building production-grade solutions across FinTech, Healthcare, AI, and SaaS. Our products include  JustInterview.ai  (AI hiring) and Sparrow (API testing).

**Who Owns What**

The Principal Engineer owns architecture decisions. That covers system design, technology and database choices, service boundaries, security and compliance architecture, and the engineering standards used across projects. These decisions are documented through design reviews and architecture decision records (ADRs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end system architecture and make the final call on technical decisions across client projects.
* Design secure, compliant, and high-performance full-stack applications, with HIPAA, SOC 2, and similar requirements built into the architecture from day one.
* Define cloud architecture on Azure, AWS, or GCP, including containerized deployments, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
* Drive API design, service boundaries, data modeling, and database architecture.
* Ensure production reliability, security, auditability, and performance.
* Establish engineering standards and lead design and code reviews.
* Mentor senior engineers and work directly with client and business stakeholders on technical trade-offs.
* Stay hands-on with coding and production-level problem-solving.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 3 months:** You ve reviewed the architecture of our active client projects, flagged the main security and compliance risks, and started producing ADRs for new design decisions.
* **By 6 months:** New projects start from a reference architecture and standards you ve defined. Senior engineers are building against them with fewer architecture escalations.
* **By 12 months:** Our systems pass client security and compliance audits (HIPAA, SOC 2) without major findings. Production incidents tied to design issues are measurably down, and at least one senior engineer is growing toward an architecture role under your mentorship.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 6+ years of software engineering experience, including proven ownership of architecture for production systems.
* Hands-on experience designing systems under HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, or GDPR, including access controls, audit logging, data encryption, and audit readiness.
* Background in Healthcare, FinTech, Payments, Insurance, or another security-sensitive domain.
* Strong expertise in Node.js, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
* Hands-on cloud architecture experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP; Azure preferred).
* Strong understanding of system design, microservices, distributed systems, and databases.
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills, including explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with high-scale production systems (100,000+ users).
* Kubernetes, event-driven architecture, and high-availability systems.
* Payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen).
* Experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot.

**Why Join Techdome**

* Independent and profitable engineering organization.
* Direct ownership of production-grade products.
* Global collaboration across India, Dubai, and the US.

* Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 **IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD**

* Hands-on familiarity with CNCF ecosystem technologies.

We offer:

* A collaborative, innovative environment where your ideas have impact.
* Opportunities to work on cutting-edge infrastructure and AI/ML technology.

547972a2d2a5.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to build, operate, automate, and continuously improve highly available cloud-native infrastructure powering blaZops SaaS platform. You will work across public cloud, Kubernetes, compute, storage, networking, observability, and infrastructure automation, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, security, and reducing manual operations.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure fundamentals with a software engineering and automation mindset: someone who proactively identifies operational issues and engineers permanent solutions rather than relying on repetitive manual processes.

Specific Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solid understanding of Linux administration and infrastructure fundamentals
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized microservices
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Ansible)
* Strong automation/scripting skills in Python and Bash (PowerShell a plus)
* Good understanding of networking, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and cloud routing
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms
* Understanding of CI/CD, Git, APIs, and modern DevOps practices
* Experience troubleshooting distributed production environments
* Understanding of security, IAM/RBAC, secrets, certificates, and infrastructure security
* Familiarity with database operations a plus

Preferred Skills

* Experience operating hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud environments
* Experience with VMware, Nutanix, OpenShift, or similar private-cloud technologies
* Experience building automated remediation or self-healing workflows
* Familiarity with AIOps, event correlation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted operations
* Understanding of FinOps and cloud cost optimization
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow
* Cloud, Kubernetes, Linux, or Terraform certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP) are a strong plus

Responsible For

* Cloud & Infrastructure Operations: design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot cloud-native infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including compute, storage, networking, and containers; handle provisioning, upgrades, patching, and capacity management; resolve connectivity, DNS, and load-balancing issues
* Site Reliability Engineering: define and improve SLIs/SLOs, monitor for reliability risks, and drive incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews; automate away recurring operational work and improve system resilience through redundancy and automated recovery
* Kubernetes & Microservices: deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized microservices on Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), including ingress, storage, secrets, and cluster health
* Infrastructure as Code & Automation: automate provisioning and operational workflows with Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash; build reusable IaC modules integrated into CI/CD
* Monitoring & Observability: implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.) with meaningful dashboards and low-noise alerting
* Networking & Security: troubleshoot cloud networking (VPC/VNet, DNS, VPN, firewalls, load balancers); apply IAM/RBAC, secrets, and least-privilege security practices
* Incident & Production Support: participate in on-call rotations, own incidents end-to-end, and maintain runbooks and automated remediation procedures
* Cost & Performance Optimization: identify underutilized resources and support FinOps initiatives (rightsizing, scheduling, lifecycle management) while balancing cost with reliability

SRE Mindset

* Automate before repeating, and engineer permanent fixes instead of resolving the same incident twice
* Treat infrastructure and operational configuration as code
* Design for failure and recovery, and measure reliability using data
* Build reusable automation and operational standards
* Reduce operational toil and unnecessary tickets
* Continuously improve reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency

Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a minimum of 70%
* SRE Engineer: 2-6 years of relevant Cloud/Infrastructure/DevOps/SRE experience
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a strong plus

**Job Nature** Full Time

**Experience** 2-6 years

**Job Location** Remote

**Job Level** Sr. Position

Apply

 **About the role**   

You will be the final level of technical support for an AI tutoring platform that Emplay runs in production for a large enterprise client. When an issue cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, it comes to you. You will find the root cause in the code or the infrastructure, fix it, release the fix safely and make sure it does not come back.

The role covers both development and DevOps. Some days you will be debugging a backend service. Other days you will be tracing a failed deployment or a monitoring alert.

* Track all work in Azure DevOps, keep tickets updated and meet the agreed response and resolution times.
* Work with the development team on fixes that need a product change, and with QA on regression before release.

 **Requirements**   

* 3 to 5 years in software development, DevOps or production support, with at least 2 years on AWS.
* Hands-on Python or Node.js, with the ability to read, debug and fix code you did not write.
* Working knowledge of AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, S3, Cognito and IAM.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker and infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch or Splunk.
* A structured approach to incidents: reproduce, isolate, fix, verify and document.
* Clear written and spoken English, for incident updates to the client and the internal team.
* Williness to work a rotational shift that includes nights.

* Exposure to generative AI applications: Amazon Bedrock, LLM prompts, agents, MCP or RAG pipelines.

 **Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn and gradient-boosted models.

61a9f59c11ca.description:
**About the role**

This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against.

If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you.

What youll build

**The runtime**

* Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations.
* Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity.

**Reliability**

* Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation.
* Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown.

**Tools, context, and memory**

* Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems.
* Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation.

**Evaluation and observability**

* Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths.
* Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results.
* Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow.

**Security**

* Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required.

**Delivery and leadership**

* Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks.
* Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria.

What you bring

* **8+ years of software engineering**, including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work.
* **2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain**, and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved.
* **Deep LangGraph knowledge:** state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware.
* **Agent harness experience:** extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution.
* **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls.
* **Retrieval engineering:** permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* **Strong Python:** async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture.
* **Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals:** PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.
* **Real experience with LLM failure modes:** unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them.
* **Observability:** OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing.
* **Cloud delivery:** Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* **AI-native development:** you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them.
* **Clear communication:** you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision.

**Location Type**
-----------------

Technology

  

**About Polygon Labs**
----------------------

Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications.

**Your Role**
-------------

Join a small strike team of interoperability and protocol experts building the next generation of Polygon’s infrastructure. As a Senior Rust Engineer, you will design, build, and operate systems across Agglayer and paychannels, with an immediate focus on paychannels. Your work will span secure interoperability and high-frequency payments: systems that connect chains, process signed payments offchain, and settle balances onchain. You will turn protocol designs into reliable software, working closely with engineers across cryptography, smart contracts, product, and infrastructure.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You will take components from design through implementation, testing, and production operation, making clear tradeoffs between performance, security, correctness, and simplicity.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain production Rust services and protocol components across Agglayer and paychannels.
* Build paychannel infrastructure for payment verification, balance accounting, and settlement, working across offchain services and onchain contracts.
* Contribute to Agglayer’s Rust infrastructure for cross-chain verification and settlement.
* Profile and improve throughput, latency, resource usage, and reliability using reproducible benchmarks.
* Make failure handling explicit: test concurrency, retries, recovery, and invalid inputs so systems preserve correctness under load and disruption.
* Work with protocol and security engineers to review designs, document assumptions, and address findings.
* Own delivery end to end, including design documents, code review, automated tests, observability, and production debugging.
* Collaborate across teams and contribute clear documentation and maintainable code to shared and open-source projects.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* A track record of shipping and maintaining production software, including substantial hands-on Rust experience.
* Strong command of Rust’s ownership model, asynchronous programming, concurrency, and error handling.
* Experience designing distributed systems, with sound judgment about consistency, persistence, networking, and failure recovery.
* Experience building blockchain infrastructure, payment systems, or similarly demanding systems where correctness and security matter.
* Ability to reason about protocol state transitions, signatures, and data integrity, and translate specifications into tested implementations.
* Practical experience profiling performance and diagnosing production issues.
* Ability to own complex work with minimal guidance, communicate design tradeoffs clearly, and collaborate effectively in a small team.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Ethereum or EVM infrastructure, smart-contract integrations, or onchain settlement.
* Familiarity with payment or state channels, high-throughput ledgers, or micropayment infrastructure.
* Experience with cross-chain interoperability, bridges, or zero-knowledge proof systems.
* Experience with property-based testing, fuzzing, adversarial testing, or protocol security reviews.
* Contributions to open-source Rust or blockchain projects.
* Experience using AI coding tools effectively while maintaining rigorous review and verification.

**Polygon Labs Perks**

The goal of the Polygon Labs total rewards program is to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our comprehensive compensation plan includes the following benefits for our full time employees:

Polygon Labs is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Polygon Labs is committed to treating all people in a way that allows them to maintain their dignity and independence. We believe in integration and equal opportunity. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.

**About Catalys:**

We are a performance marketing agency specializing in driving success for e-commerce and D2C businesses. Our remote work culture ensures you can achieve targets from the comfort of your home.Right now, we're on the lookout for a Full-Stack Developer who's excited about building SaaS products from the ground up! You will play a key role in building and scaling the SaaS products Catalys is taking to market. If you're up for an exciting ride, read on!

**About the Role**

As a Full-Stack Developer at Catalys, you'll work on our growing portfolio of SaaS products. From building UI screens and APIs to designing database schemas and wiring up third-party integrations, you'll ship features end to end that real businesses rely on daily.

You'll work directly with the Product Manager in a fast-moving startup environment. Priorities shift, requirements evolve as we learn from users, and you'll often take a feature from idea to production in days, not months. AI is at the core of how we build. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Wispr Flow every day to move fast, while still owning the quality, security, and reliability of what you ship.We don't expect you to know everything on day one. We do expect you to learn fast, ask good questions, and take ownership of your work.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and ship full-stack features for production SaaS products.
* Design database schemas, write migrations, and implement secure access controls.
* Build APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations (Meta, Google, Slack, CRMs).
* Turn rough requirements, designs, or a quick conversation into clean, responsive, production-ready features.
* Use AI tools effectively, and review, test, and refine the code they generate.
* Debug production issues, monitor logs, and keep products secure, performant, and reliable as they scale.
* Document what you build so the team can understand, maintain, and extend it.
* Share ideas on product and user experience. Your input will shape what we build.

**Who You Are*****Technical skills***

* You have 0–2 years of full-stack experience. Freshers will be considered only if they have built real projects (please share GitHub or live links).
* You have solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3.
* You've built with Next.js and Node.js, and you're comfortable with modern frontend tooling like Tailwind CSS.
* You have working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL.
* You understand REST APIs, authentication, and webhooks.
* You use Git confidently in a collaborative environment.

***How you work***

* You use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as an afterthought.
* You debug patiently and test your own work before calling it done.
* You're comfortable with changing priorities and can figure things out without detailed instructions.
* You're self-driven and work well in a remote team.

***How you communicate***

* You explain things clearly and in a structured way, whether you're typing or speaking.
* You can turn a vague idea into precise instructions, which matters a lot when you're prompting AI tools by voice or text.
* You're comfortable talking with stakeholders. You can understand what they need, ask the right questions, and explain technical trade-offs in simple language.
* You give clear progress updates and flag blockers early.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Supabase (Auth, Row Level Security, Edge Functions, Realtime).
* Familiarity with Meta Marketing APIs or Google APIs.
* Basic exposure to Android / React Native.
* Prior experience building a SaaS product.

**What we offer:**

* Permanent remote work (pajamas encouraged!)
* Competitive salary (we value your time and effort!)
* Fun and supportive team culture (we value good vibes and killer memes!)
* Growth opportunities to learn and develop your skills
* Direct ownership of features and products used by real businesses.
